summary: Identifies the declared receive signal supplied by the selected carrier terminal.
description: Identifies the declared receive signal supplied by the selected carrier terminal. A protection communication interface carries information between circuit ends or couples a communication signal to a primary line. Its signal path is different from the power-current path even when both use part of the same installation.

In a switchyard line bay, carrier-coupling equipment can connect a protection communication terminal to the transmission conductor. Fiber-based protection uses another physical path but still needs named endpoints and channel supervision. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Received carrier signal” at the input and “Protection receive indication” at the output. A receive indication is distinct from channel health.
